prompt_en: In some countries, students pay their college or university fees, while in some others, the government pays for them. Do you think the advantages that the government pays the money outweigh the disadvantages?
thesis_en: The advantages outweigh the disadvantages only where the support is means-tested, since universal funding moves money towards students who will later out-earn the taxpayers paying for it.
truc_name: Nguồn Lực Công Và Ai Chịu Trách Nhiệm
prompt_vi: Ở một số nước sinh viên tự trả học phí đại học, ở nước khác thì nhà nước trả. Việc nhà nước trả có lợi nhiều hơn hại không?

key_vocab.vi: sinh viên nhà thu nhập thấp
chuyển ngân sách từ chỗ này sang chỗ khác

prompt_en: Some people think secondary school students should study international news as one of their subjects, while others believe that this is a waste of valuable school time. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
thesis_en: Both sides are arguing about what the timetable should give up, and international news earns a place only if it replaces a weaker subject rather than being added on top.
truc_name: Nguồn Lực Công Và Ai Chịu Trách Nhiệm
prompt_vi: Có ý kiến cho rằng học sinh trung học nên học tin quốc tế như một môn riêng, ý kiến khác cho rằng như vậy là phí thời gian học. Bàn cả hai phía và nêu quan điểm của ta.

key_vocab.vi: đẩy một môn yếu hơn ra
theo dõi tình hình quốc tế
thời khoá biểu vốn đã kín
nhóm học sinh đọc tốt nhất
dùng được cho bậc học sau

prompt_en: Young people today face high academic pressure. Some people argue that governments should invest in after-school activities to alleviate this stress. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Funded activities help only if they replace paid tutoring rather than sitting on top of it, since what harms the child is the total number of hours worked.
truc_name: Nguồn Lực Công Và Ai Chịu Trách Nhiệm

prompt_en: It is more important to spend public money promoting a healthy lifestyle in order to prevent illness than to spend it on the treatment of people who are already ill. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Prevention tends to deliver more health per unit of spending, yet it cannot be funded by cutting treatment, because the people already ill have no alternative provider.
truc_name: Nguồn Lực Công Và Ai Chịu Trách Nhiệm

prompt_en: In many countries, children are becoming overweight and unhealthy. Some people think that the government should have the responsibility. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Government carries the part of this that families cannot reach alone, namely what is sold at the school gate and what a healthy meal costs relative to an unhealthy one.
truc_name: Nguồn Lực Công Và Ai Chịu Trách Nhiệm

prompt_en: Some people say in order to prevent illness and disease, government should focus on reducing environmental pollution and housing problems. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Air quality and housing reach every resident of a district at once, which makes them a better use of a health budget than campaigns that reach only those already paying attention.
truc_name: Nguồn Lực Công Và Ai Chịu Trách Nhiệm

prompt_en: To build a better future for a city, investment should be made in young people. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Investment in young people pays back over a longer horizon than most council budgets run, and that mismatch is the real obstacle rather than any disagreement about the value.
truc_name: Nguồn Lực Công Và Ai Chịu Trách Nhiệm

prompt_en: Many countries spend large amounts of money preparing athletes for major competitions, whereas others argue that these funds should instead be prioritized for children to participate in sports from a young age.
thesis_en: Elite funding buys visibility and participation funding buys health, and since the second reaches far more people the case for redirecting the money is stronger.
truc_name: Nguồn Lực Công Và Ai Chịu Trách Nhiệm

prompt_en: Some people believe that it is important for governments to pay for large pieces of art, such as sculptures, to put on public display in outdoor places. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Outdoor art is worth public money where people pass it without choosing to, and hard to justify where the same sum would keep a library open.
truc_name: Nguồn Lực Công Và Ai Chịu Trách Nhiệm

prompt_en: Towns and cities are attractive places. Some people suggest that the government should spend money putting in more works of art like paintings and statues to make them better to live in. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Art improves a street that already works and cannot rescue one that does not, so it belongs after the pavement and the lighting rather than before them.
truc_name: Nguồn Lực Công Và Ai Chịu Trách Nhiệm
note_teacher: Gần trùng với đề Nghệ thuật số 1. Cùng kho ý, khác mỗi loại hình nghệ thuật.

prompt_en: A significant amount of time and resources is dedicated to protecting wild animals. To what extent do you agree or disagree that these resources should be spent elsewhere?
thesis_en: I disagree, because extinction is the one outcome on the list of competing claims that no later budget can reverse.
truc_name: Nguồn Lực Công Và Ai Chịu Trách Nhiệm

prompt_en: Films and computer games containing violence are popular. Some people say they have a negative effect on society and should be banned. Others say they are just harmless relaxation. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
thesis_en: Neither description fits, since the effect appears negligible for most players and concentrated in a small minority, which argues for enforced age limits rather than prohibition.
truc_name: Cấm Và Hạn Chế Có Hiệu Quả Không

prompt_en: Some countries have introduced laws to limit working hours for employees. Why are these laws introduced? Do you think they are a positive or negative development?
thesis_en: These laws exist because an individual worker cannot refuse extra hours without cost, and they are positive precisely because they take that choice away from the individual.
truc_name: Cấm Và Hạn Chế Có Hiệu Quả Không

prompt_en: Long distance flight consumes the amount of the fuel that a car uses for many years and pollutes the air. Some people think that we should discourage non-essential flights, such as tourist travel, rather than limit the uses of the cars. Do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Flights are the easier target and the smaller prize, since car use is daily and universal while long-haul flying is occasional and concentrated among a few travellers.
truc_name: Cấm Và Hạn Chế Có Hiệu Quả Không

prompt_en: Some people believe that the best way to solve the world's environmental problem is to increase the cost of fuel for cars and other vehicles. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Pricing fuel changes behaviour faster than persuasion does, though calling it the best way overstates the case while millions have no alternative route to work.
truc_name: Cấm Và Hạn Chế Có Hiệu Quả Không

prompt_en: Some people think that shops should not be allowed to sell food or drinks that are scientifically proven to be bad for people's health. What extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: A sales ban relocates the purchase rather than preventing it, so the stronger measure is to change what is cheapest and most visible on the shelf.
truc_name: Cấm Và Hạn Chế Có Hiệu Quả Không

prompt_en: The only way to improve safety on our roads is to give much stricter punishments for driving offences. What extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Harsher penalties work only when drivers expect to be caught, which makes enforcement rather than severity the binding constraint.
truc_name: Cấm Và Hạn Chế Có Hiệu Quả Không

prompt_en: Some cities have banned private vehicles, such as cars and motorcycles, on designated car-free days, allowing only bicycles and public transportation. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this policy and give your own opinion.
thesis_en: The gain is a day of clean air and a visible proof of concept, the cost is a disruption that local businesses absorb each time, and the balance turns on whether the city builds anything permanent afterwards.
truc_name: Cấm Và Hạn Chế Có Hiệu Quả Không

prompt_en: Some people think that the best way to improve road safety is to increase the minimum legal age for driving a car or motorbike. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Raising the age only postpones the risk, since accident rates appear to track inexperience more closely than youth.
truc_name: Cấm Và Hạn Chế Có Hiệu Quả Không

prompt_en: Many customs and traditional ways of behavior are no longer relevant to modern life and not worth keeping. Do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: I disagree, because relevance is the wrong test, and customs that carry practical knowledge fall out of use long before anyone decides they are obsolete.
truc_name: Truyền Thống So Với Hiện Đại, Và Bản Sắc
prompt_vi: Nhiều phong tục và lối ứng xử truyền thống không còn phù hợp với đời sống hiện đại và không đáng giữ. Ta đồng ý hay không đồng ý?

key_vocab.vi: còn dùng được trong đời sống

key_vocab.academic: practical knowledge carried in a custom
key_vocab.vi: tri thức thực hành nằm trong phong tục

key_vocab.basic: do it in front of others
key_vocab.vi: thực hành trước mặt người khác
không ai tuyên bố nó lỗi thời
một tuần làm việc bình thường

prompt_en: In some parts of the world it is becoming increasingly popular to try to find out one's own family history. Why do you think people do this? Do you think it is a positive or negative development?
thesis_en: People look for a fixed point when the places their families came from have changed beyond recognition, and the development stays positive so long as it remains curiosity rather than becoming a claim.
truc_name: Truyền Thống So Với Hiện Đại, Và Bản Sắc

prompt_en: If people go to live in another country, they should follow the local customs and traditions. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Newcomers owe compliance with the local rules that affect other people, and nothing beyond that, and the difficulty is that most societies disagree about where that line falls.
truc_name: Truyền Thống So Với Hiện Đại, Và Bản Sắc

prompt_en: In some parts of the world, traditional food is gradually being replaced by fast food, and this trend is having a negative effect on families and society. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this belief?
thesis_en: I agree in part, since what disappears is the shared meal rather than the recipe, and the loss is an hour families used to spend together rather than a cuisine.
truc_name: Truyền Thống So Với Hiện Đại, Và Bản Sắc

prompt_en: To what extent do you agree or disagree that international fast food is replacing traditional food and negatively affecting families and society?
thesis_en: I agree in part, since what disappears is the shared meal rather than the recipe, and the loss is an hour families used to spend together rather than a cuisine.
truc_name: Truyền Thống So Với Hiện Đại, Và Bản Sắc
note_teacher: Trùng nội dung với đề Thực phẩm và sức khỏe số 3. Cùng kho ý, chỉ khác cách diễn đạt.

prompt_en: Museums and art galleries should concentrate on works that show history and culture of their own country rather than works of the other parts in the world. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: A collection that shows only its own country teaches visitors nothing about where that country sits, which defeats the purpose of putting the objects side by side.
truc_name: Truyền Thống So Với Hiện Đại, Và Bản Sắc

prompt_en: Many people say that schools are no longer necessary as a lot of information is available on the internet, so children can study at home. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Schools supply supervision, sequencing and peers rather than information, and no search engine provides any of the three.
truc_name: Công Nghệ Thay Thế Cái Cũ, Lợi Ích Không Đều
prompt_vi: Nhiều người nói trường học không còn cần thiết vì thông tin trên mạng đã rất nhiều, nên trẻ có thể tự học ở nhà. Ta đồng ý tới mức nào?

key_vocab.vi: sự trông chừng của người lớn
tự học ở nhà không ai kèm
biết bước tiếp theo học gì

prompt_en: Many people think modern communication technology is having some negative effects on social relationships. Do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: The technology raised the number of contacts a person has and lowered the cost of ending any one of them, and it is the second change that does the damage.
truc_name: Công Nghệ Thay Thế Cái Cũ, Lợi Ích Không Đều

prompt_en: More and more people no longer read newspapers or watch TV programs to get news. They get news about the world through the Internet. Is this a positive or negative development?
thesis_en: This is negative in its current form because the shift removed the editor without replacing the function the editor was performing.
truc_name: Công Nghệ Thay Thế Cái Cũ, Lợi Ích Không Đều

prompt_en: Some groups of people have benefited from modern communications technology, but some people do not benefit at all. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: I agree, and the group that gains least is defined by which services have withdrawn their offline alternative rather than by age.
truc_name: Công Nghệ Thay Thế Cái Cũ, Lợi Ích Không Đều

prompt_en: Some people think that the rapid development of smart mobile devices, e.g. smartphones, tablets and other mobile devices, are disadvantageous to human. Agree or disagree?
thesis_en: The devices themselves are neutral, whereas the design choices that make them hard to put down are a commercial decision rather than a technical necessity.
truc_name: Công Nghệ Thay Thế Cái Cũ, Lợi Ích Không Đều
prompt_vi: Có ý kiến cho rằng điện thoại thông minh, máy tính bảng và các thiết bị di động phát triển quá nhanh nên gây hại cho con người. Đồng ý hay không đồng ý?

key_vocab.basic: not the fault of the phone
key_vocab.vi: bản thân thiết bị trung tính

prompt_en: More people today put their personal and private information online (address, telephone number, credit card number) to do everyday activities such as banking, shopping, and socializing. Is this a positive or negative development?
thesis_en: This remains a negative development while the person who supplies the data carries the loss when it leaks, since nothing else pushes the holder to protect it.
truc_name: Công Nghệ Thay Thế Cái Cũ, Lợi Ích Không Đều

prompt_en: Many people believe robots are important for humans' future developments, while others think robots are dangerous and have negative effects on society. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
thesis_en: Both views describe the same machine under different labour rules, and since the saving currently goes to the owner rather than the displaced worker, I share the second concern.
truc_name: Công Nghệ Thay Thế Cái Cũ, Lợi Ích Không Đều

prompt_en: Some people think technology development decrease crime while others believe it actually encourages crime. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
thesis_en: Technology appears to have relocated crime more than reduced it, moving it from a street where it was visible to a network where much of it is neither reported nor counted.
truc_name: Công Nghệ Thay Thế Cái Cũ, Lợi Ích Không Đều

prompt_en: There have been many inventions in human history, such as the wheel. Some people think the most important thing is the internet. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
thesis_en: The internet changed how fast we exchange what is already known, which is a narrower claim than calling it the most important invention, and a defensible one.
truc_name: Công Nghệ Thay Thế Cái Cũ, Lợi Ích Không Đều

prompt_en: Nowadays, fewer people are writing by hand due to the widespread use of computers and digital technology. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
thesis_en: The advantages outweigh the disadvantages, though what we give up is the selection that slow writing forced rather than the skill of forming letters.
truc_name: Công Nghệ Thay Thế Cái Cũ, Lợi Ích Không Đều

prompt_en: Nowadays, a growing number of children are committing crimes. What are the reasons for this, and what punishments should be imposed?
thesis_en: Many of these offences follow an absent adult more than any criminal disposition, so punishment should stay supervised and proportionate, and has to arrive alongside an intervention in the household.
truc_name: Răn Đe So Với Cải Tạo
prompt_vi: Ngày càng nhiều trẻ vị thành niên phạm tội. Nguyên nhân là gì, và nên áp dụng hình phạt nào?

key_vocab.vi: tái phạm trong vòng một năm

key_vocab.academic: the hours between school and dinner
key_vocab.vi: khoảng thời gian tan học tới bữa tối

key_vocab.academic: an older group on the same street
key_vocab.vi: nhóm lớn tuổi hơn ở cùng khu

prompt_en: Some people believe that providing criminals with education will reduce the recidivism rate. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Education reduces reoffending where it ends in a qualification an employer will accept, and changes nothing where it does not.
truc_name: Răn Đe So Với Cải Tạo

prompt_en: Research shows that many criminals continue to commit crimes after being released from prison. What is the cause and solution?
thesis_en: The cause is the absence of legal income in the first weeks after release, so any solution has to reach the employer and the landlord rather than the prison alone.
truc_name: Răn Đe So Với Cải Tạo

prompt_en: Research shows that most criminals have low levels of education. Therefore, some believe that the best way to reduce crime is to educate prisoners while in prison so they can secure employment upon release. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Low education signals the same disadvantage that produced the offence, so training only works when it is paired with an employer prepared to read past the record.
truc_name: Răn Đe So Với Cải Tạo
note_teacher: Gần trùng với đề Tội phạm số 4. Cùng luận điểm, bản này nói rõ thêm mắt xích việc làm.

prompt_en: Some people believe that young people who commit crimes should receive the same punishments as adults. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Identical punishment assumes identical judgement, and the reason almost every legal system sets an age of majority is that it does not believe that.
truc_name: Răn Đe So Với Cải Tạo

prompt_en: Nowadays, some parents put a lot of pressure on their children. What is the reason for this? Is this a positive or negative development for the children?
thesis_en: Parents apply pressure because school places are rationed by marks, so the development is negative for the child while remaining rational for the family.
truc_name: Tuổi Thơ, Học So Với Chơi, Và Ai Định Hình Đứa Trẻ
prompt_vi: Ngày nay một số cha mẹ tạo rất nhiều áp lực cho con. Nguyên nhân là gì, và đây là chuyển biến tích cực hay tiêu cực đối với đứa trẻ?

key_vocab.vi: suất học phân theo điểm số
lớp học thêm có trả phí

key_vocab.academic: lose hours of sleep a week
key_vocab.vi: mất mấy giờ ngủ mỗi tuần

prompt_en: The values that we learn from our parents and family have a greater influence on our future success than knowledge and skills we learn at school. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Family shapes whether a child keeps going after a setback and school supplies what they keep going at, and for the kind of success most people have in mind the family influence is the greater of the two.
truc_name: Tuổi Thơ, Học So Với Chơi, Và Ai Định Hình Đứa Trẻ

prompt_en: Recently, many parents have suggested that their children should spend less time studying and instead devote more time to physical activities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: I agree, because the hours added to study are taken from sleep and attention rather than from idleness.
truc_name: Tuổi Thơ, Học So Với Chơi, Và Ai Định Hình Đứa Trẻ

prompt_en: Children today find it difficult to concentrate on or to pay attention to school. What are the reasons? How can we solve this problem?
thesis_en: Attention has not fallen so much as competition for it has risen, so the workable solutions concern the hours around school rather than the lesson itself.
truc_name: Tuổi Thơ, Học So Với Chơi, Và Ai Định Hình Đứa Trẻ

prompt_en: In recent years, an increasing number of parents are choosing to educate their children at home rather than sending them to school. Do the advantages of home education outweigh the disadvantages?
thesis_en: The disadvantages outweigh the advantages for most families, since home education needs one adult with both the free hours and the subject range, and few households have either.
truc_name: Tuổi Thơ, Học So Với Chơi, Và Ai Định Hình Đứa Trẻ

prompt_en: Some people believe that individuals under 18 years old should focus all their time on education. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Focusing all their time on education produces students who do well in examinations and have practised nothing that examinations leave out.
truc_name: Tuổi Thơ, Học So Với Chơi, Và Ai Định Hình Đứa Trẻ

prompt_en: Many parents suggest that children should spend less time studying and more time engaging in physical activities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: I agree, because the hours added to study are taken from sleep and attention rather than from idleness.
truc_name: Tuổi Thơ, Học So Với Chơi, Và Ai Định Hình Đứa Trẻ
note_teacher: Trùng nội dung với đề Giáo dục số 2. Chỉ khác cách mở câu.

prompt_en: Some people argue that language learning is only effective in small classes, while others believe that class size does not matter. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
thesis_en: Those who say size does not matter are describing what a teacher explains, while the other side is describing how many minutes of speaking each learner gets, and for a language it is the second that decides progress.
truc_name: Tuổi Thơ, Học So Với Chơi, Và Ai Định Hình Đứa Trẻ
note_teacher: Đề mồ côi. Engine của nó là TIME, giờ giáo viên chia cho bao nhiêu học sinh, chứ không phải engine chính của Trục 6.

prompt_en: Some students choose to work or travel after leaving school and before going to university. Many people, however, say that working experience is more useful in adult life than travel. Do you agree or disagree with this statement?
thesis_en: Work teaches what a workplace expects and travel teaches what to do when nothing is familiar, and only the first of those is tested in the year after graduation.
truc_name: Động Lực Làm Việc, Tiền So Với Phi Tiền
prompt_vi: Một số học sinh chọn đi làm hoặc đi du lịch sau khi rời trường phổ thông, trước khi vào đại học. Nhiều người lại nói kinh nghiệm làm việc hữu ích hơn du lịch trong đời sống trưởng thành. Ta đồng ý hay không?

key_vocab.academic: a year between school and university
key_vocab.vi: một năm giữa phổ thông và đại học
điều nơi làm việc đòi hỏi
năm đầu sau khi tốt nghiệp
giấy chứng nhận nhà tuyển dụng chấp nhận
gia đình có tiền chi trả
tự xoay khi không có hướng dẫn

prompt_en: Remote work benefits employees more than employers. Agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Employees gain hours and employers gain floor space and retention, so the claim holds mainly in the first year, before firms adjust what they expect in return.
truc_name: Động Lực Làm Việc, Tiền So Với Phi Tiền

prompt_en: Employers should give their staff at least 4-week holiday a year to help employees perform better in their jobs. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Longer leave raises output in roles where fatigue is the limiting factor and does very little in roles where it is not.
truc_name: Động Lực Làm Việc, Tiền So Với Phi Tiền

prompt_en: Money is considered the primary factor in motivating employees in the workplace. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Pay is decisive up to the point where it covers what a household needs, and above that line it retains people without making them work any harder.
truc_name: Động Lực Làm Việc, Tiền So Với Phi Tiền

prompt_en: The only reason why people work hard is to earn money and there is no other reason for doing so. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: The word only makes this indefensible, since the same person will often work hardest on the unpaid task they chose for themselves.
truc_name: Động Lực Làm Việc, Tiền So Với Phi Tiền

prompt_en: There are old people who can not mentally, physically, financially look after themselves. Should they be legally supported by young family members? To what extent do you agree or disagree.
thesis_en: A legal duty places the cost on whichever relative has the least bargaining power, most often a daughter, so the obligation belongs with a state that can spread it.
truc_name: Công Bằng Giữa Các Nhóm Và Giữa Các Thế Hệ
prompt_vi: Có những người già không thể tự lo cho mình về tinh thần, thể chất hay tài chính. Con cháu trẻ tuổi có nên bị luật buộc phải chu cấp không? Ta đồng ý tới mức nào?

key_vocab.vi: nghĩa vụ chu cấp theo luật

key_vocab.basic: the one who cannot say no
key_vocab.academic: the relative with least bargaining power
key_vocab.vi: người thân ít quyền từ chối nhất

key_vocab.academic: a cost the state can spread
key_vocab.vi: khoản nhà nước san đều được
chăm sóc không công tại nhà

prompt_en: Some people believe that women should play an equal role as men in a country's police force or military force, while others think women are not suitable for these kinds of jobs. Discuss both views and give opinion.
thesis_en: Those who doubt suitability are pointing at a job description, and that description was written when only one group was applying, so I side with equal access and with rewriting the description around what the work now needs.
truc_name: Công Bằng Giữa Các Nhóm Và Giữa Các Thế Hệ

prompt_en: In many countries, life expectancy is increasing, leading to a growing proportion of elderly people. What problems does this cause for individuals and society, and what are the reasons for this trend?
thesis_en: Longer lives are the product of earlier medical care and safer work, while pensions and care systems were designed around a shorter one, and it is that mismatch which strains households and budgets alike.
truc_name: Công Bằng Giữa Các Nhóm Và Giữa Các Thế Hệ

prompt_en: Some people think that schools should select students according to their academic abilities, while others believe that it is better to have students with different abilities studying together. Discuss both views and state your own opinion.
thesis_en: Selecting by ability lets a teacher pitch one lesson at one level, yet the measure used records a family's circumstances as much as a child's, which is why I favour mixed classes with setting only in the exam years.
truc_name: Công Bằng Giữa Các Nhóm Và Giữa Các Thế Hệ

prompt_en: Interviews are one of the ways to recruit employees in many companies. Some people believe that interviews are an unreliable way of choosing employees, while other people believe that there are better methods. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
thesis_en: An interview measures how comfortable a candidate is in an interview, which is why it belongs alongside a work sample rather than in place of one.
truc_name: Công Bằng Giữa Các Nhóm Và Giữa Các Thế Hệ

prompt_en: Professional workers like doctors, nurses and teachers make a greater contribution to society, so they should be paid more than sports and entertainment personalities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Contribution and pay are set by different mechanisms, so this works as a case for raising public salaries rather than for lowering private ones.
truc_name: Công Bằng Giữa Các Nhóm Và Giữa Các Thế Hệ

prompt_en: The directors of large organizations receive much higher salaries than ordinary workers. Some people consider this to be unfair. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
thesis_en: The gap is defensible where it tracks a decision only one person can make, and indefensible where it survives several years of poor decisions.
truc_name: Công Bằng Giữa Các Nhóm Và Giữa Các Thế Hệ

prompt_en: Most countries aim to improve their standard of living through economic development, but many important social values can be lost as a result. Do the advantages of economic development outweigh the disadvantages?
thesis_en: The advantages outweigh the disadvantages where growth funds the services that hold a community together, and not where it merely raises average income.
truc_name: Tăng Trưởng Đánh Đổi Môi Trường
prompt_vi: Phần lớn các nước muốn nâng mức sống bằng phát triển kinh tế, nhưng nhiều giá trị xã hội quan trọng có thể mất đi. Lợi có nhiều hơn hại không?

key_vocab.academic: the services that hold a community together
key_vocab.vi: dịch vụ giữ cộng đồng lại với nhau

key_vocab.academic: move to the city for work
a village with no working-age adults

cấp tiền cho ngành y tế
đáng với cái giá phải trả

prompt_en: The natural resources such as oil, forests and fresh water are being consumed at an alarming rate. What problems does it cause? How can we solve these problems?
thesis_en: The central problem is that the cost of depletion sits outside the price of the product, so the workable solutions put it back inside the price.
truc_name: Tăng Trưởng Đánh Đổi Môi Trường

prompt_en: Pollution and environmental damage are inevitable as a country becomes richer and more developed. Do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: I disagree, since countries at similar income levels differ widely on exactly this, which points to regulation rather than wealth as the deciding factor.
truc_name: Tăng Trưởng Đánh Đổi Môi Trường

prompt_en: As demand for oil and gas increases, some people advocate searching for these energy sources in untouched natural areas. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh its disadvantages?
thesis_en: The disadvantages outweigh the advantages, because the gain is a finite quantity of fuel and the damage is permanent on any human timescale.
truc_name: Tăng Trưởng Đánh Đổi Môi Trường

prompt_en: Nowadays, there are many celebrities who are famous for their glamour and wealth rather than achievements and this sets a bad example for young people. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: I agree that the example is a poor one, though it is set by whatever earns attention rather than by any one person, so blaming the celebrity changes nothing.
truc_name: Truyền Thông Định Hình Nhận Thức Và Hành Vi

prompt_en: Nowadays young people are admiring media and sports stars, even though they often do not set a good example. Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
thesis_en: Admiration is normal and useful, and the negative part is that the range of people young audiences are shown has narrowed.
truc_name: Truyền Thông Định Hình Nhận Thức Và Hành Vi

prompt_en: Some people say that news is a good medium to learn, while others argue that other media are more effective. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
thesis_en: News reports what is happening and rarely why, so it works as a supplement to structured material rather than a substitute for it.
truc_name: Truyền Thông Định Hình Nhận Thức Và Hành Vi

prompt_en: These days consumers are faced with an increasing amount of advertising from various companies. To what extent do you think consumers are influenced by advertising? What measures should be taken to protect them?
thesis_en: Advertising rarely decides a single purchase yet steadily shapes what a shopper treats as normal, so protection should govern what may be advertised to whom rather than how much.
truc_name: Truyền Thông Định Hình Nhận Thức Và Hành Vi

prompt_en: Some people believe that watching TV is bad for children, while others claim it has positive effects as children grow up. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
thesis_en: The positive case concerns what a child takes from a programme and the negative one what the hour replaces, and the second effect is the larger of the two.
truc_name: Truyền Thông Định Hình Nhận Thức Và Hành Vi

prompt_en: In some countries, celebrities complain about the way the media publicize their private lives. Some people say that they should accept it as part of their fame. Do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Fame is not consent to unlimited coverage, since the trade on offer was publicity for the work rather than access to a household.
truc_name: Truyền Thông Định Hình Nhận Thức Và Hành Vi
prompt_vi: Ở một số nước, người nổi tiếng phàn nàn về việc báo chí đưa tin đời tư của họ. Có người cho rằng đó là cái giá phải trả của sự nổi tiếng. Đồng ý hay không đồng ý?

key_vocab.vi: sự tò mò của công chúng

key_vocab.basic: important for the public to know
key_vocab.vi: vấn đề vì lợi ích công

prompt_en: News plays an important part in most people's lives and news media has become more influential in people's lives. Why do you think this is the case? Is it a positive or negative development?
thesis_en: Influence grew because the supply of news became continuous while the day did not get any longer, and the development is negative because attention became the thing being sold.
truc_name: Truyền Thông Định Hình Nhận Thức Và Hành Vi

prompt_en: Media coverage of violent crime frightens people and encourages criminals. Some people say it should be banned from newspapers and TV programmes. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Coverage can produce the conditions it reports, which argues for rules on how crime is reported rather than a ban on reporting it.
truc_name: Truyền Thông Định Hình Nhận Thức Và Hành Vi

prompt_en: Some people believe that the sole purpose of advertising is to encourage consumers to buy products they do not actually need. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: The word sole is what makes this too strong, since advertising also carries the information that a product exists at all.
truc_name: Truyền Thông Định Hình Nhận Thức Và Hành Vi

prompt_en: Some people believe that news media should focus more on reporting positive news rather than negative stories. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: A commitment to positive coverage removes first the story that would embarrass somebody, and that is the reporting a public most needs.
truc_name: Truyền Thông Định Hình Nhận Thức Và Hành Vi

prompt_en: Some people say that what children watch on television influences their behavior, others say that the amount of time children watch on television influences their behavior most. Discuss both views.
thesis_en: Content changes what a child copies and duration changes what the child never learned to do instead, and the second effect is the larger one.
truc_name: Truyền Thông Định Hình Nhận Thức Và Hành Vi

prompt_en: Some people think the increasing business and cultural contact between countries brings many positive effects. Others say it causes the loss of national identities. Discuss both of these views and give your own opinion.
thesis_en: Contact adds far more than it removes, and what does disappear tends to be the local practice that nobody was ever paid to keep going.
truc_name: Toàn Cầu So Với Địa Phương

prompt_en: Some people say that the increasing business and cultural contact between countries has positive effects. Others say it would lead to the loss of national identities. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
thesis_en: Contact adds far more than it removes, and what does disappear tends to be the local practice that nobody was ever paid to keep going.
truc_name: Toàn Cầu So Với Địa Phương
note_teacher: Trùng với đề Văn hóa xã hội số 2. Chỉ khác chữ think và say.

prompt_en: Some people believe it is better to import foreign films and TV programs, while others argue that countries should produce their own shows. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
thesis_en: Importing is cheaper only in the first years, since a country that stops commissioning soon has nobody left who can write a full season.
truc_name: Toàn Cầu So Với Địa Phương

prompt_en: Most of today's urgent problems could be solved by international cooperation. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Cooperation works on problems where no single country can capture the benefit of acting alone, and stalls on every problem where one can.
truc_name: Toàn Cầu So Với Địa Phương

prompt_en: Many parents these days work in other countries, taking their families with them. Do you think the advantages of this development outweigh its disadvantages?
thesis_en: The advantages outweigh the disadvantages for the parents and are far less clear for a child moved partway through secondary school.
truc_name: Toàn Cầu So Với Địa Phương

prompt_en: Today's food travels thousands of miles before it reaches customers. Why is this the case? Is this a positive or negative development?
thesis_en: Distance is a symptom of a price that leaves transport out, and the development is negative mainly because local producers are made to compete against a price that leaves out a cost somebody else is carrying.
truc_name: Toàn Cầu So Với Địa Phương

prompt_en: Some people think that charity organizations should only offer help to people of their own country. But others believe that these organizations should give aid to people in great need wherever they live. Discuss.
thesis_en: Need rather than nationality is the more defensible test for an organisation funded by voluntary giving.
truc_name: Toàn Cầu So Với Địa Phương

prompt_en: Important historical objects should be returned to their country of original. Agree or disagree?
thesis_en: I agree, since the argument for keeping them rests on access rather than ownership, and access can be arranged by loan.
truc_name: Toàn Cầu So Với Địa Phương

prompt_en: Some people think that it is necessary to travel abroad to learn about other countries, while other people think that it is not necessary to travel abroad because all the information can be seen on TV and the Internet. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
thesis_en: Screens teach the facts about a place and travel teaches what it feels like to be the one who does not know the rules, and only the second changes how somebody thinks.
truc_name: Toàn Cầu So Với Địa Phương

prompt_en: The use of bicycles as the main form of transport has declined in many places. Why and what can be done to encourage people to use bicycles more?
thesis_en: The decline follows how dangerous a route feels rather than any change in willingness, so separated infrastructure is the answer rather than persuasion.
truc_name: Quy Hoạch Đô Thị Và Khoảng Cách Vật Lý
prompt_vi: Việc dùng xe đạp làm phương tiện chính đã giảm ở nhiều nơi. Vì sao, và làm gì để khuyến khích người ta đạp xe nhiều hơn?

secure parking at the other end

prompt_en: In many cities, governments have located shops, office, schools far from each other. Do you think the advantages of this policy outweigh the disadvantages?
thesis_en: The disadvantages outweigh the advantages, because separating these functions creates a daily journey that every household then pays for in time or in fares.
truc_name: Quy Hoạch Đô Thị Và Khoảng Cách Vật Lý

prompt_en: In many modern cities, urban planners locate shops, schools, and housing in separate, distinct areas. What are the causes of this development, and is it a positive or negative trend?
thesis_en: The separation grew out of a planning logic that treated housing and noise as incompatible, and it has proved negative because the cost lands on residents rather than on planners.
truc_name: Quy Hoạch Đô Thị Và Khoảng Cách Vật Lý
note_teacher: Cùng hiện tượng với đề Giao thông số 2 và Đô thị số 2, nhưng khác dạng câu hỏi. Bản này hỏi thêm nguyên nhân, nên bố cục bài khác hẳn.

prompt_en: Some people suggest that moving factories and industrial sites to rural regions can solve urban problems. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Moving the factory moves the pollution and the commute rather than removing either, unless the housing moves with it.
truc_name: Quy Hoạch Đô Thị Và Khoảng Cách Vật Lý

prompt_en: It is important for all towns and cities to have large public outdoor places like squares and parks. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
thesis_en: Public outdoor space is the only ground in a city that people who would never otherwise meet have to share, and that is what the land is buying.
truc_name: Quy Hoạch Đô Thị Và Khoảng Cách Vật Lý

prompt_en: Some believe that history has little to teach us about today while others think that the study of the past helps us to understand the present. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
thesis_en: History rarely predicts what will happen, yet it reliably shows which arrangements are recent, and that is what stops people treating the present as inevitable, so the second view is the stronger one.
truc_name: Giá Trị Của Thứ Không Sinh Lời
prompt_vi: Có người cho rằng lịch sử ít dạy được gì cho hôm nay, người khác cho rằng học quá khứ giúp hiểu hiện tại. Bàn cả hai phía và nêu quan điểm của ta.

key_vocab.basic: think it was always this way
key_vocab.vi: coi hiện tại là tất yếu
những người đặt ra luật lệ
thay đổi vẫn là chuyện làm được

prompt_en: Some people view sport merely as a leisure activity, while others argue that it plays a vital role in society. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
thesis_en: Sport is one of the few settings where people who share nothing else follow the same rules, and that is a civic function rather than a leisure one.
truc_name: Giá Trị Của Thứ Không Sinh Lời

prompt_en: In today's world of advanced science and technology, we still greatly value our artists such as musicians, painters and writers. What can the arts tell us about life that science and technology cannot?
thesis_en: The arts hold the first-person side of an experience, which is exactly the part a scientific account has to remove in order to be general.
truc_name: Giá Trị Của Thứ Không Sinh Lời

prompt_en: Many animals are in danger of extinction. Some people think that we should only protect animals that are useful to humans. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Usefulness is judged at one moment and applied to a loss that no later judgement can undo, which makes it the wrong test.
truc_name: Giá Trị Của Thứ Không Sinh Lời

prompt_en: The tendency of human beings to copy one another is shown in the popularity of areas such as fashion and consumer goods. To what extent do you agree?
thesis_en: I agree, though the imitation here is largely manufactured by how goods are marketed, and is not a fixed feature of human character.
truc_name: Áp Lực Đồng Dạng Và Kỳ Vọng Xã Hội

prompt_en: People's shopping habits depend more on the age group they belong to than other factors. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
thesis_en: Age tends to predict less than income does, and what looks like a generational habit is usually the price bracket a person can reach.
truc_name: Áp Lực Đồng Dạng Và Kỳ Vọng Xã Hội

prompt_en: Many children face pressure from their peers to conform to certain behaviors. Do the disadvantages of peer pressure outweigh the advantages?
thesis_en: The disadvantages outweigh the advantages in adolescence specifically, because the mechanism that teaches a child to cooperate is the same one that stops them leaving a group that is harming them.
truc_name: Áp Lực Đồng Dạng Và Kỳ Vọng Xã Hội

prompt_en: An increasing number of people are choosing to have cosmetic surgery in order to improve their appearance. Why do people have operations to change the way they look? Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
thesis_en: People act on a standard set by the faces they see most often, and the development is negative because that standard shifts again each time somebody meets it.
truc_name: Áp Lực Đồng Dạng Và Kỳ Vọng Xã Hội

prompt_en: In many parts of the world, people now often throw things away when they are broken and buy new ones, whereas in the past, old things were repaired and used again. Discuss.
thesis_en: Repair disappeared once it became more expensive than replacement, which makes this a pricing outcome rather than a change in attitude.
truc_name: Áp Lực Đồng Dạng Và Kỳ Vọng Xã Hội

prompt_en: More and more people today expect to get what they want instantly (e.g. goods, services, news), without having to wait. Why is this? Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
thesis_en: Expectations follow whatever the fastest available service has trained people to accept, and the development is negative mainly because the skills that need a slow start are the first to be dropped.
truc_name: Áp Lực Đồng Dạng Và Kỳ Vọng Xã Hội
